name: trusted_authors
description: GitHub logins whose PR comments and reviews fire the fixer; only their threads are handed to the agent

name: ignored_check_apps
description: Check-suite app slugs the settle step ignores (the claude suite stays queued)

name: checks_settle_timeout_s
description: Seconds after a head SHA's first check completion before it settles anyway (settled_by timeout)

name: checks_settle_min_s
description: Minimum seconds before all_completed settles, so a slower app's suite can appear

name: fixer_repos
description: Repositories (owner/name) the fixer runs on (the allow-list); widen with: variables add fixer_repos owner/repo

name: fixer_excluded_repos
description: Repositories (owner/name) the fixer never runs on, even when in fixer_repos (an override)

name: fixer_comment_triggers
description: What a PR comment or review comment must carry to start a fixer run: a /command at the start of its body, or an @mention of the App (narrow it to ["/fix"] to ignore mentions)

name: fixer_stop_triggers
description: What a PR comment must start with to stop the PR's fixer story (d34): a /command, or the App's @mention followed by the word (narrow it to ["/stop"] to ignore mentions)

name: fixer_protected_paths
description: Paths the gate's diff guard refuses (on top of the .github/workflows/** floor)

name: fixer_levels
value: level=1 actor=claude-fixer reviewer=qwen-reviewer pool=claude-spark queue=pr-fixer-claude enabled=false
level=2 actor=qwen-fixer reviewer=codex-reviewer pool=qwen-spark2 queue=pr-fixer enabled=true
level=3 actor=codex-fixer reviewer=qwen-reviewer pool=codex-spark queue=pr-fixer-codex enabled=true
description: #39, #56: the fixer's three escalation levels in order (level 1 Claude ships disabled until the Claude bridge is live; level 2 Qwen; level 3 Codex), one per string: level, actor (the fixer), reviewer, pool (its concurrency pool: the level queue's cap), queue (the level's own queue) and enabled. Try n takes the n-th enabled level (the last one repeats); edit a field in place to enable a level

name: fixer_unavailable
description: #39: what a try does when its level is unavailable (actor disabled or deleted, token budget spent, capacity cooldown): next (the next available level after it) or hand_back (end the story with one hand-back)

name: fixer_capacity_cooldown_s
description: #39: seconds a fixer level rests after one of its tries hit the backend's usage limit (capacity_exhausted); meanwhile queue.progress skips it as vars.fixer_unavailable says
